authority.source_of_truth: Reviewed source, versioned contracts, and accepted evidence on the default branch.
authority.task_authority: GitHub issues plus WorkContract and experiment protocol identities.
authority.acceptance_authority: Independent executable predicates and evidence packets bound to exact candidates.
authority.deployment_authority: Protected Fleet workflows and separately authenticated infrastructure identities.

data.retention: Source and accepted evidence are retained through Git history; restricted runtime artifacts remain outside the public repository.
data.deletion: Secrets, private traces, and unauthorized data must be removed from active storage and history remediated when exposure occurs.
data.secret_storage: GitHub environments, cloud identity, and private Fleet configuration; never repository content.

change_control.rollback_or_revocation: Candidate artifacts, tool grants, and deployment authority are revocable independently; Fleet owns operational rollback.

stabilization.summary: Own and pin the common repository governance validator used across modern repositories.
Qualify repository-grounded agent work through frozen candidates, sealed evaluation, and observable trajectories.
Apply the shared resource-policy profile consistently at context, corpus, MCP, evaluation, and publication boundaries.
